title: Product Catalog Inquiries: Chassis Configurations & Axle Ratios
description: Foundational sales English module covering product catalog inquiries: chassis configurations & axle ratios.
learning_objectives: Master professional Question Formation with Wh- Words in technical sales and export contracts
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in product catalog inquiries: chassis configurations & axle ratios
Demonstrate mastery in international negotiations and Incoterms documentation

questions.prompt: Our sales manager regularly _____ the revised quotation for twenty 8x8 chassis to the Egyptian ministry.

explanations.correct: Singular subject takes 3rd person singular Present Simple with '-s' ('sends').
explanations.wrong_C: Participle 'sending' cannot act as finite verb without auxiliary.
explanations.wrong_D: 'is send' is an ungrammatical verb phrase.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'manažer posílá'. English 3rd person singular takes -s: 'sends'.
